Azure Government note: Copilot in Power BI/Fabric is Commercial-focused / Verify for Gov. Treat as conceptual unless confirmed available for your tenant.

Conceptual tasks:
1. Potential Copilot-assisted workflows for this model: narrative summaries of the Lab 05 performance findings, natural-language Q&A over Sales Amount/Gross Margin by Territory/Product Category, and DAX/measure-authoring assistance while building new pages.
2. Tenant, capacity, licensing, and data boundary requirements: Copilot in Fabric/Power BI requires an eligible Fabric capacity (F64+ in most SKUs), tenant-level Copilot enablement by an admin, and respects the same workspace/data boundaries as the underlying semantic model — it does not bypass RLS or existing sharing permissions.
3. Human validation requirements: any Copilot-generated narrative, DAX, or Q&A answer must be checked against the underlying measures/visuals before being shared externally or used for a business decision — Copilot can misinterpret ambiguous natural-language questions or generalize from a filtered view.
4. Non-AI fallback per workflow: narrative summaries -> author them manually from the same visuals; natural-language Q&A -> use the built-in Q&A visual (non-Copilot) or well-labeled existing visuals; DAX authoring -> use the documented measure patterns and error-tracking knowledge base already built for this project (see pbip_error_log) instead of AI-generated DAX.

Deliverable for this exercise: for each of the three workflows above, write one sentence confirming whether it is validated for this tenant, and its non-AI fallback if not.
